caption: Against a bright white background, a feathery blue mass occupies the left side, with darker cobalt pooling near the lower corner and pale cyan tendrils extending outward. The blue region remains largely fixed in place, its edges shifting only subtly as fine wisps diffuse through the bright field. A yellow-orange bloom then becomes visible on the right, presenting a dense central mass surrounded by radiating pale-yellow petals. Its center stays roughly in place while the flower-like footprint enlarges, the petals lengthening and thinning toward the white space. As the yellow mass spreads, the pale gap between it and the blue plumes narrows, bringing the two colored regions closer, a faint greenish blend forming at the boundary. The blue formation continues its slow edge movement throughout, still anchored on the left while its tendrils soften and shift. The yellow bloom remains in active expansion, while the blue plumes continue their slow diffusion.
relations: The blue mass anchored left continues slow edge diffusion, its tendrils softening against the white field.
A yellow-orange bloom emerges on the right, its dense center fixed while petals lengthen and thin outward.
As yellow spreads leftward, the pale gap narrows, forming a faint greenish blend where yellow meets cyan.
The blue formation remains stationary on the left throughout the yellow expansion.
